result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, but pedestrians must cross a wide multi-lane roadway without a refuge island. While traffic signals are present, dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not clearly visible, increasing risk during the long crossing distance.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross the wide intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility marked crosswalk and overhead traffic signals, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The surrounding environment is industrial with significant pavement degradation, which may impact pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and potholes in the roadway surface near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to eliminate tripping hazards and improve vehicle control.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and traffic signals, but the environment remains car-oriented with wide crossing distances. Sidewalks are present but appear narrow and are bordered by industrial fencing, which may impact the perceived safety and comfort of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island at a wide intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Fencing and vegetation on the left corner may partially block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features wide travel lanes and faded crosswalk markings, creating a high-exposure environment for pedestrians. There is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific infrastructure such as signals or refuge islands, and large commercial vehicles further complicate sightlines.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Blind Spots
hazards.description: The presence of a large delivery truck in the intersection creates visual obstructions for both pedestrians and other drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded parallel lines with continental-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian countdown signals and push buttons to provide clear crossing phases.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
